correctness.rationale: Connectivity forces selected leaves to have selected supports and forces the selected cycle vertices to form the whole cycle or one consecutive path. A complementary block of length one is forceable exactly when at least one boundary leaf is selected; a block of length two is forceable exactly when both boundary leaves are selected (with \(n=3\) separately excluded); a longer block stalls after the boundary forces. The counting formula follows from these disjoint cases. Exhaustive verification for \(3\le n\le9\) checks every subset and every coefficient; the infinite result rests on the proof, not the computation.

value.rationale: The coefficient sequence \(z_c(G;i)\) is explicitly promoted as a natural object in the recent connected-forcing-density literature. Sunlets are a canonical unicyclic family and a boundary case excluded from the nontrivial-attached-graph corona theorem. The result supplies a complete structural classification, every coefficient, the minimum-basis count, and the total count in closed form; it is therefore more than a scalar recomputation and directly addresses a natural enumerative gap.
